answer: Each agent binds its identity to a unique hardware lotus attested by a TPM quote. Before any public ocean of graded tasks appears, the agent commits a hash of that quote. After reveal it must produce the matching proof within 120 seconds on the mesa of verifier nodes. Clones sharing one chip generate identical serials; the rule flags them and slashes the full 2500 POA bond on every linked identity. An attacker forging 200 fakes therefore needs 200 separate chips at roughly $15 each plus locked capital, while a single honest agent only waits the reveal window.
